
# Electronics & Controls Power Systems Private Limited

> Electronics & Controls Power Systems Private Limited is a power systems company based in Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It designs and manufactures online UPS systems from 1 kVA to 1200 kVA, industrial inverters, voltage stabilizers, battery chargers and related power products, and supplies batteries, solar systems and EV chargers.

Official website: https://www.eandcpower.com/

## Company Information

- **Company name:** Electronics & Controls Power Systems Private Limited
- **CIN:** U31200KA1997PTC022448
- **Address:** 29/A, 2nd Phase, Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560058, India
- **Also known as:** E&C Power Systems
- **In power electronics since:** 1978
- **Phone:** 080 2839 7120 (sales) / 080 2837 1974 / 080 2837 9401
- **Email:** sales@eandcpower.com
- **Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM IST
- **Service area:** Products are designed and manufactured in Bengaluru and supplied across India through E&C's sales and service network.
- **Logo:** https://www.eandcpower.com/image/logo2.png

## Products and Solutions

- [Power Protection for Textile Mills: UPS, Stabilizers and What Goes Where](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/power-protection-for-textile-mills): Which textile mill loads need a UPS and which need a stabilizer: looms, spinning, embroidery and dyeing controls, plus dust, lint and DG coordination.

- [Solar Hybrid Systems for Factories: Self-Consumption, Backup and DG Integration](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/solar-hybrid-system-for-factories): Designing a solar hybrid system for a factory: matching solar to daytime load, backing up critical loads, working with the DG, and sizing.

- [UPS Battery Replacement: When and How to Replace a Battery Bank](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-battery-replacement-guide): Signs a UPS battery bank needs replacing, how impedance and discharge tests work, whole string vs single block replacement, and safe recycling of old batteries.
- [UPS Efficiency and Running Cost: What a Few Percent Is Worth](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-efficiency-and-running-cost): How UPS efficiency turns into kWh lost and heat to remove, with a worked example, part-load efficiency, eco mode trade-offs and what to ask for.
- [UPS for Airports and Transport Hubs: Designing for Zero Interruption](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-airports): Power backup for airports, metro and bus terminals in India: critical loads, redundant UPS design, battery rooms, monitoring and working with authorities.
- [UPS for Banks, ATMs and BFSI Branches: A Practical Guide](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-banks-and-atms): How to choose UPS and power backup for bank branches, ATMs and BFSI offices in India: loads, backup time, redundancy, remote monitoring and service.
- [UPS for Broadcast, Media and Research Laboratories](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-broadcast-and-research-labs): How to plan online UPS for TV and radio studios, playout and uplinks, and for research labs with sensitive instruments, long experiments and clean power needs.
- [UPS for CCTV, Access Control and Security Rooms](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-cctv-and-security-systems): How to back up CCTV cameras, NVRs, PoE switches, access control and security rooms with UPS: sizing, backup time, outdoor cameras and monitoring.
- [UPS for Diagnostic Centres: Imaging, Lab Analysers and PACS](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-diagnostic-centres): Which diagnostic centre loads need an online UPS: CT, MRI and X-ray consoles, lab analysers and PACS, the split with the DG, and managing many sites.
- [UPS for Government, PSU and Insurance Offices](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-government-and-psu-offices): UPS planning for government departments, PSU companies and insurance offices in India: typical loads, tender specs, standardisation, monitoring and AMC.
- [Online UPS for Hotels and Hospitality: Front Desk to Banquet Hall](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-hotels-and-hospitality): Which hotel loads need online UPS, from front office and PMS servers to key cards, kitchens and banquets, plus sizing, noise, space and service tips.
- [UPS for Oil, Gas and Petrochemical Plants](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-oil-gas-and-petrochemical-plants): How industrial UPS powers control, safety and telecom loads in refineries, gas and chemical plants: layout, DC systems, Ni-Cd batteries and siting.
- [UPS and Battery Backup for Railways and Metro Signalling](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-railways-and-metro): Which railway and metro loads need backup, how DC battery systems, chargers, inverters and online UPS fit together, and what to check in the specification.
- [UPS for Retail Chains and Shopping Malls: What to Back Up and How](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-retail-and-malls): Which store and mall loads need an online UPS, how to size billing and server backup, centralised vs per-store UPS, monitoring and space limits.
- [UPS for SCADA, PLC and DCS Systems: AC or DC, and How to Size It](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-scada-plc-and-dcs): How to power SCADA, PLC and DCS systems: online UPS, industrial AC UPS or DC systems, redundant feeds, inrush, alarms into the control system and backup time.
- [UPS for Schools, Colleges and Universities: Planning Campus Power Backup](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-schools-and-universities): How to plan UPS for schools, colleges and universities in India: computer labs, servers, research labs, exam halls, building-wise design and service.
- [UPS for Semiconductor and Electronics Factories: Protecting Against Voltage Sags](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-semiconductor-and-electronics-factories): How electronics and semiconductor factories use online UPS against voltage sags: SMT lines, reflow ovens, test equipment and cleanroom controls.
- [UPS for Steel and Cement Plants: Heat, Dust and Dirty Power](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-steel-and-cement-plants): What an industrial UPS must handle in steel and cement plants: heat, dust, harmonics and voltage dips, which loads to protect, and how to place and size it.
- [UPS for Water and Wastewater Treatment Plants](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-for-water-treatment-plants): Where an industrial UPS fits in water and sewage treatment plants and pumping stations: PLC, SCADA, analysers, dosing, telemetry and harsh remote sites.

- [UPS Preventive Maintenance and Load Testing: What a Proper Service Visit Covers](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-preventive-maintenance-and-load-testing): What an engineer does in a UPS preventive maintenance visit: load bank testing, thermal imaging, battery discharge tests and capacitor and fan replacement.
- [What a Power Audit Checks, and When You Need One](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/what-a-power-audit-checks): What an electrical power audit measures: voltage, harmonics, power factor, earthing and UPS loading, how the logging is done, and what the report gives you.
